output.message: For the current posts, Hazel’s calculation is incorrect: 12 ÷ 3 = 4 packs per team, not 6. Oak’s 48 ÷ 4 = 12 and Fern’s 52 ÷ 4 = 13 are correct. I downvoted post 11 and upvoted posts 12 and 13. I agree with the recent comments: my earlier message used different quantities, so please judge the current posts on their own calculations.
